songs.name: Beat It On Down The Line

ai_show_review.summary: Rare early gems, crystal-clear soundboard, standout Jerry solo
ai_show_review.blurb: The set delivers rare early material such as In The Pines and Cardboard Cowboy, highlighted by Pigpen’s vibrant organ and a soaring solo from Jerry on Standing On The Corner. Soundboard quality is crystal‑clear, offering full‑frequency detail throughout the brief six‑song set.
ai_show_review.review: On July 17 1966 at San Francisco’s Fillmore Auditorium the Dead served up an electrifying snapshot of their garage‑band era.  From the opening “Big Boss Man” through a tight run that includes the only known live version of “In The Pines,” the band moves with surprising fluidity; Pigpen’s organ cuts a bright, West‑Coast tone while Phil’s bass drives the groove forward.  The highlight is Jerry’s blistering solo on “Standing On The Corner,” which reviewers call one of his finest early improvisations, and his snarling, “horny” guitar tone that shines across the set.  Recorded straight from the house board, the audio is described as crystal‑clear and full‑sounding with strong bass presence and bouncy keys, making this perhaps the best‑documented glimpse of the Dead’s pre‑psychedelic sound.

best_recording.reason: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture that includes the full set, rare tracks (In The Pines, Cardboard Cowboy) and Jerry’s standout solo.

key_highlights: Rare early gems: In The Pines and Cardboard Cowboy
Jerry Garcia delivers a soaring solo on Standing On The Corner
Pigpen’s organ provides a bright, West‑Coast texture throughout
Exceptional soundboard quality – crisp, full‑frequency, no dropouts

band_performance.Jerry: Delivers one of his finest early solos on Standing On The Corner; guitar tone described as snarling and horny, cutting through the mix.
band_performance.Phil: Active, moving bass that drives the sound forward and underpins the set with solid foundation.
band_performance.Billy: Tight drumming that anchors the band; early‑era rhythm work praised for its strength.

must_listen_sequences: Beat It On Down The Line
